moves.reason: Add Corbin while the roster has an open slot: he already has 15 points, was given first pick, and coupled with Kenzie, giving Jolie exposure to a separate couple rather than stacking the existing three.
evidence: “As the newest arrival, Corbin was given first pick, to which he chose Kenzie.”

advice.summary: Yes—use the open roster spot on Corbin. His power pick and new couple give him a stronger Week 1 base than the newly arrived islanders who are still single.
